title: Microglial heterogeneity in the ischemic stroke mouse brain of both sexes
design: To characterize microglial diversity after permanent stroke in Tmem119-2A-CreERT2;Ai6 mice in which microglia were labeled with ZsGreen, we sorted ZsGreen positive cells on day 3 after stroke for scRNA-seq analysis. Four samples were analayzed: female_sham, female_stroke, male_sham, and male_stroke,  (F_Sham, F_Stroke, M_Sham, M_Stroke). Each sample were pooled from 4 mice.
new_candidates.reason: Microglia-specific sorting; one library per sex-condition, 4 mice pooled per library; day 3 permanent stroke.

title: Physical exercise improves the neuronal function in ischemic stroke via microglial CB2R/P2Y12 signaling
design: To investigate the regulative mechnism and explore the potential target to protect against the ischemic stroke, C57BL/6J mice were suffered from transient middle cerebral artery occlusion.
new_candidates.reason: Six bulk RNA samples; supplementary FPKM/annotation spreadsheets, no single-cell barcode counts.

title: A molecular brain atlas reveals cellular shifts during the repair phase of stroke
design: The study was designed to generate a single-cell atlas of stroke-injured mouse tissue one month following permanent focal cerebral stroke. we used nine stroked adult male and female mice (3-5 months old) with a C57BL/6J background. We validated a successful stroke induction using Laser Doppler imaging and collected tissue from stroke, peri-infarct and intact cortex. We dissociated the tissue and isolated nuclei for subsequent snRNAseq analysis
new_candidates.reason: One-month permanent stroke atlas: 9 mice overall but only 3 regional libraries (stroke core/peri-infarct/contra), not 9 independent expression samples.

title: Transcriptome analysis of the course of ischemic stroke from acute to chronic phase in mice
design: B6.129S4-Pdgfratm11(EGFP)Sor/J mouse brain were dissociated enzymatically, and then the cell suspensions were isolated by cell sorting (FACS) according to absence of Sytox signal. The sorted cells were analyzed using single cell RNA sequencing.
new_candidates.reason: Six scRNA libraries titled brain_1 through brain_6; GEO does not map them to conditions. Linked study concerns control/Sham/day3/day14, without 24h. Cannot infer group n from total six libraries.

title: Transcriptome analysis of the course of ischemic stroke from acute to chronic phase in mice [2]
design: Mouse cerebral infarcts were produced in a model of distal middle cerebral artery occlusion (dMCAO). The mice were divided into four groups: 3 days post-stroke, 14 days post-stroke, the control group, and the sham surgery group. Each brains brain tissue is mechanically dissociated, and cell membranes are lysed using enzymatic treatment and detergents to isolate and purify the nuclei. After confirming the quality of the nuclei, a library is prepared, and single nucleus RNA sequencing is performed.
new_candidates.reason: One snRNA library each for Healthy, ShamOpe, CI_Day3, CI_Day14.

title: Inhibition of microglial SLC2A5 attenuates brain injury following acute ischemic stroke [scRNA-Seq]
design: (1)brain cortex were isolated for scRNA-seq from  P35-40 widetype and Slc2a5 knockout mice. (2) Brain samples were harvested from widetype and Slc2a5 knockout mice with 24 hours after tMCAO, followed by library preparation using standard 10x Genomics workflows and snRNAseq (NovaSeq 6000, Illumina). Left and right hemispheres were sequenced separately. Hence, we obtained datasets from the contralateral and ipsilateral to ischemic lesion.(3) brain microglia was isolated by FACS from P35-40 widetype and Slc2a5 knockout mice, and culture them under oxygen-glucose deprivation(OGD) condition with or with 24 hours recovery.The library for sequencing was prepared following the protocol for SMARTer Stranded Total RNA-Seq Kit v2.
new_candidates.reason: One WT cortex, one WT ipsi and one WT contra library plus KO counterparts; 24h but no replicated sham comparison.

title: SnRNA-seq, snATAC-seq and Stereo-seq datasets of mouse striatum at different time points in MCAO/R
design: Multiome-seq: Single nuclei were extracted from unimmunized mice and immunized mice at 0 h, 24 h, 7 d and 14 d post-MCAO/R. Joint snRNA-, scATAC and Stereo-seq libraries were prepared using the BGI Genomics.
new_candidates.reason: Table S1 reports three biological replicates and RNA libraries per Sham/24h condition; original matrices downloaded, QC complete and both target types adequate. Individual mouse/pool map absent; assay/platform/region differ.

title: Single cell sequencing data supporting "IL-4/C1q activated astrocyte-derived extracellular vesicles promote stroke infarct recovery by recruiting peripheral leukocytes"
design: Mice subjected to ischemic stroke received implantation of different reactive astrocyte derived extracellular vesicle-functionalized hydrogel microparticles into the infarct cavity at 5 days post-stroke. Ipsilateral brain hemispheres were harvested at day 14 after stroke and processed for single-cell RNA sequencing. Comparative transcriptomic analysis was performed to evaluate treatment-associated changes in cellular heterogeneity, immune cell recruitment, vascular remodeling, and tissue repair within the post-stroke microenvironment.
new_candidates.reason: D14 reactive-astrocyte EV hydrogel treatment groups, no Sham contrast and one library/group.
